name: Haus Erbhof
beschreibung:
Sunnily situated in Soelden, Erbhof welcomes visitors with comfortable rooms and rustic Tyrolean ambiance. It offers an authentic retreat in the heart of the Oetztal.

Major cable car base stations, cross-country ski tracks, and hiking paths are within easy reach.
kurzbeschreibung: Haus Erbhof in Soelden combines traditional alpine farm charm with cosy living comfort.
